modules.name: Family and Members
modules.description: Shows family and member counts, lists, drill-downs and downloads for Raghuvir Admin and Society Manager users.

requirements.title: Per-project family and member summary for Raghuvir Admin
requirements.description: Raghuvir Admin sees, per project, families, total members, each age group, Age Not Given, owner-living and tenant-living families, vacant flats and average members per family, with a grand total row.

requirements.title: Drill-down from project to building to flat
requirements.description: When a project row is clicked on the web, the same counts show by building, then by flat.

requirements.title: Filters for counts and list
requirements.description: On the web, filters for project, building, age group, and owner or tenant update the counts and the list.

requirements.title: Download member list as Excel
requirements.description: On the web, Raghuvir Admin can download the member list as an Excel file, and the download is saved in the activity log. Priority is Should.

requirements.title: Society Manager summary on mobile
requirements.description: On mobile, a user with View family data permission sees own project counts by building, including owners vs tenants, plus the member list (view only).

rules.title: Residents and Watchmen cannot see other families
rules.description: A Resident or Watchman must not see any other family's details or counts, on web or mobile.

rules.title: Family and member definitions
rules.description: A Family is one approved flat. A Member is a person added under that flat. A person belongs to one flat only.
